title: carex alpina var. holostoma
intro: Carex alpina var. holostoma, commonly known as Alpine Wood Sedge, is a plant species belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Carex alpina var. holostoma are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, lower fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
